result.evidence_quote: This study investigated Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection prevalence and disease-related knowledge among spouses of reported HBV cases in Quzhou City to support family-based interventions reducing intra-familial transmission.
result.rationale: The study focuses on HBV prevalence, knowledge, and prevention of intra-family transmission. It does not address cardiovascular disease, cardiovascular risk prediction or prevention, or therapies for cardiovascular outcomes.
